typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	v_SysBatchLogKey as string (),
	v_TempTableScheduleApplsources as string ()
}

source(output(
		ScheduleDesc as string,
		BenefitID as string,
		ISDateOFServiceEnabled as boolean,
		StateID as string,
		ScheduleID as long,
		ServiceID as string,
		ClaimSubTypeID as string,
		SysPartitionKeyStart as long,
		SysPartitionKeyEnd as long,
		ServiceDtEnd as date,
		ClaimPaidDtEnd as date,
		ServiceDtStart as date,
		ClaimPaidDtStart as date,
		ApplSourceID as string,
		ApplSourceCd as integer,
		ClaimTyp as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select Distinct           SCH.ScheduleID         ,SCH.ScheduleDesc         ,APL.ApplSourceID         ,APL.ApplSourceCd         ,APL.StateID         ,APL.BenefitID         ,APL.ServiceID         ,Case when APL.ClaimTypeID =\'E\' then \'P\'         	  else APL.ClaimTypeID	           	  End As ClaimTyp         ,CST.ClaimSubTypeID         , CASE WHEN APL.ISDateOFServiceEnabled=1 		       THEN Convert(BigInt,(Convert(Varchar,APL.ApplSourceCd) + Left(Convert(Varchar,Convert(datetime2,SCH.ScheduleDateOfSvcStartDtTm),112),6))) 		       ELSE Convert(BigInt,(Convert(Varchar,APL.ApplSourceCd) + Left(Convert(Varchar,Convert(datetime2,SCH.ScheduleDateRangeStartDtTm),112),6))) 			   END                                                                                                                       As  SysPartitionKeyStart         ,CASE WHEN APL.ISDateOFServiceEnabled=1 		       THEN Convert(BigInt,(Convert(Varchar,APL.ApplSourceCd) + Left(Convert(Varchar,Convert(datetime2,SCH.ScheduleDateOfSvcEndDtTm),112),6))) 			   ELSE Convert(BigInt,(Convert(Varchar,APL.ApplSourceCd) + Left(Convert(Varchar,Convert(datetime2,SCH.ScheduleDateRangeEndDtTm),112),6)))  			    END                                         As   SysPartitionKeyEnd 		,Convert(Date,SCH.ScheduleDateRangeStartDtTm) ClaimPaidDtStart 		,Convert(Date,SCH.ScheduleDateRangeEndDtTm) ClaimPaidDtEnd 		,Convert(Date,SCH.ScheduleDateOfSvcStartDtTm) ServiceDtStart 		,Convert(Date,SCH.ScheduleDateOfSvcEndDtTm) ServiceDtEnd 		,APL.ISDateOFServiceEnabled     From EIDS_ENC.vwApplication.ScheduleLog            SCH (nolock)    Inner Join           EIDS_ENC.vwApplication.ScheduleApplSourcesLog SAS (nolock)      On  SCH.SysScheduleLogKey = SAS.SysScheduleLogKey     Inner Join          EIDS_ENC.vwConfig.ApplSources                 APL (nolock)       On SAS.ApplSourceID  = APL.ApplSourceID    Inner Join          EIDS_ENC.vwConfig.ClaimSubTypes               CST (nolock)       On CST.ClaimTypeID = APL.ClaimTypeID    Where SCH.SysScheduleLogKey = ?;',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODSScheduleApplSources
ODSScheduleApplSources sink(input(
		ScheduleDesc as string,
		BenefitID as string,
		ISDateOFServiceEnabled as boolean,
		StateID as string,
		ScheduleID as string,
		ServiceID as string,
		ClaimSubTyp as string,
		SysPartitionKeyStart as long,
		SysPartitionKeyEnd as long,
		ServiceDtEnd as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ClaimPaidDtEnd as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ServiceDtStart as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ClaimPaidDtStart as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ApplSourceID as string,
		ApplSourceCd as integer,
		ClaimTyp as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ScheduleDesc,
		BenefitID,
		ISDateOFServiceEnabled,
		StateID,
		ScheduleID,
		ServiceID,
		ClaimSubTyp = ClaimSubTypeID,
		SysPartitionKeyStart,
		SysPartitionKeyEnd,
		ServiceDtEnd,
		ClaimPaidDtEnd,
		ServiceDtStart,
		ClaimPaidDtStart,
		ApplSourceID,
		ApplSourceCd,
		ClaimTyp)) ~> ODDScheduleApplSources
